# Drivex Greenville

> Premium private rides, airport transfers and executive transportation for anyone in Greenville and Upstate South Carolina.

Drivex Greenville is operated by Drivex Transport LLC, an SC PSC-approved Class C carrier (SC PSC Class C Charter Certificate, Docket No. 2026-182-T · Order No. 2026-402). Service is by advance reservation, with 24/7 dispatch, flight-aware airport pickups and fixed rates. The site is available in English and Spanish.

- Address: 46 Bellwood Farms Ln, Greenville, SC 29607
- Phone (24/7 Dispatch): +1 864-807-7230
- Email: dispatch@drivexgreenville.com
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/18648077230
- Area served: Greenville · GSP · CLT · ATL

Rates and availability are confirmed only through the booking form or dispatch.

## Services

- [24/7 Airport Transfers (GSP · CLT · ATL)](https://drivexgreenville.com/#services): Guaranteed private service at any hour. Real-time flight monitoring and punctual pickup for families, executives and individual travelers—without depending on app-driver availability.
- [Reliable Point-to-Point Rides](https://drivexgreenville.com/#services): Private local rides for appointments, events, shopping and personal plans, with confirmed pickup and a fixed rate protected from surge pricing.
- [Corporate Accounts & FBO Aviation](https://drivexgreenville.com/#corporate): Coordinated ground transportation for companies and private aviation passengers at Cerulean FBO, with centralized itineraries and consolidated billing.

## The Drivex standard

- [Punctuality Guaranteed](https://drivexgreenville.com/#standards): Planned arrival buffers, live routing and flight-aware airport pickups.
- [Silent Ride Standard](https://drivexgreenville.com/#standards): No forced conversation or audio. Your privacy and cabin preferences lead.
- [Fixed Executive Rates](https://drivexgreenville.com/#standards): Confirmed pricing before your ride, without surge-pricing surprises.

## Executive fleet

- [2026 Honda CR-V Hybrid (Executive Hybrid)](https://drivexgreenville.com/#fleet): Max 4 passengers · 3–4 executive bags · Wi-Fi · USB-C charging · Viofo 3-Cam Safety System
- [2026 Honda CR-V LX (Executive Standard)](https://drivexgreenville.com/#fleet): Max 4 passengers · 3–4 executive bags · Wi-Fi · USB-C charging · Viofo 3-Cam Safety System

## Booking

- [Web Direct via Moovs](https://drivexgreenville.com/#book): Request, confirm and pay securely online.
- [WhatsApp Business API](https://wa.me/18648077230): Send itinerary details and receive a quick quote.
- [Apply for SC Corporate Account](mailto:dispatch@drivexgreenville.com?subject=SC%20Corporate%20Account): Account-based service for aviation teams, executive offices, manufacturers and visiting leadership.

## Interstate Service Notice

- [CLT & ATL](https://drivexgreenville.com/#interstate-notice): Transfers to Charlotte (CLT) and Atlanta (ATL) cross state lines and will be offered by advance reservation at fixed rates once Drivex Transport LLC’s federal (FMCSA/USDOT) interstate operating authority is active. Contact dispatch for current availability.
